## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes — new or changed behavior comes with tests
- [ ] [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) has an entry in the user's voice (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] UI strings are localized in both `package.nls.json` and `package.nls.zh-cn.json`
- [ ] Agent behavior stays in the engine — this extension is a thin adapter, not a reimplementation
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings attached (for UI changes)
